description: Use when you need current data for an Amazon product: price and currency, list price and discount, availability, rating, review count, Best Sellers rank, brand, features, specifications and image URLs. 15 marketplaces. When Amazon shows no buy box (e.g. "Currently unavailable"), price, currency and listPrice are null and priceNote explains why; the rest of the product is returned and the call counts as successful. Unknown ASINs and errors are not charged. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.01 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

asin.description: ASIN (10 characters) or full product URL.

marketplace.description: Amazon marketplace (ignored when a full URL is given).

zip.description: Delivery ZIP/postcode for localized price and stock. Default: a marketplace default.

name: amazon_product
title: ScrapeMole: One Amazon product by ASIN or URL: price, list price, stock, rating, reviews count, Best Sellers rank, specs, images.
